values.note: FAS camping $12/night with a valid fishing license, $18 without (the split is by fishing license, not residency). FWP's 2026 fee table gives $5 / $7.50 for MT residents 62+, disabled or veterans. The page also lists conservation licenses (MT resident $8, senior/youth $4, nonresident $10).

fees.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39754135 (Facilities & Fees: 'FAS Camping Without Valid Fishing License 18.0', 'FAS Camping With Valid Fishing License 12.0') + https://fwp.mt.gov/binaries/content/assets/fwp/fish/fas/2026-fas-fee-table_adopted.pdf (as previously recorded), read 2026-10-22

sites.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39754135 (Restrictions: 'Vehicle Length Trailer Length is 25ft.'), read 2026-10-22

booking.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39754135 (Restrictions: 'Stay Limit Maximum stay of 7 days'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: FWP lists a toilet, a hand launch and primitive campsites. The site is split into a day-use area (concrete boat launch, latrine, no day-use fee) and a separate camping area; ADA accessibility rated 'Moderate'.

facilities.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39754135 (Facilities: 'Toilet', 'Hand Launch', 'Primitive Campsite'; 'This site is split into two areas - a day use area and a camping area. The day use area has a concrete boat launch; latrine; no day use fee.'), read 2026-10-22

note: Montana FWP fishing access site on the Bitterroot River with designated primitive camping: 3.7 miles south of Darby, turn east on Rocky Mountain Road 0.2 miles to the day-use site; the campsites are 0.2 miles further south off Hwy 93. Weapons discharge prohibited year round. --Claude
summary: FWP FishMT page confirms $12/$18 FAS camping, the 25-ft trailer limit, the 7-day stay limit (now recorded in booking), toilet, hand launch, primitive campsites (camping area separate from the day-use area). Year-round season (manual) unchanged. Not stated: site count, toilet type, how sites are taken (derived FCFS left), hookups (derived electric 0 left). Note trimmed of restated facilities, limits, FCFS and fees.
